patthana22.30:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca
patthana22.30:2.1: sanidassanasappaṭigho noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa. nasanidassanattika nasāsavaduka sanidassanattika sāsavadukaṃ
patthana22.30:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.30:5.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.30:6.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. ekavīsa. nasanidassanattika naāsavasāsavaduke sanidassanattika āsavasāsavadukaṃ
patthana22.30:7.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na āsavañceva na anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho āsavoceva sāsavoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.30:8.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anāsavañceva na nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho sāsavoceva nocaāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa. nasanidassanattika naāsavaāsavasampayuttaduke sanidassanattika āsavaāsavasampayuttadukaṃ
patthana22.30:9.1: nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na āsavañceva na āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho āsavoceva āsavasampayuttoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.30:10.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na āsavavippayuttañceva na nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho āsavasampayuttoceva nocaāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika āsavavippayuttanasāsavaduke sanidassanattika āsavavippayuttasāsavadukaṃ
patthana22.30:11.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho āsavavippayutto sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. ekavīsa.
patthana22.30:12.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho āsavavippayutto anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nosaññojanagocchakaduke nasanidassanattika saññojanagocchakadukaṃ
